### Added

- *(plans)* Serve the fixture scenarios in Hive and the plan list in [#3604](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3604) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(roadmap)* Serve the fixture board per fixture scenario in [#3605](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3605) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Add the Platform section's cluster page with its Overview tab in [#3578](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3578) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(layout-check)* Report tables that scroll sideways or squeeze a column, and check 1024 and 1160 in [#3607](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3607) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)

### Fixed

- *(ui-react,agent-platform)* Set no text below 12px in the facts column in [#3606](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3606) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(agent-platform)* Organizations asks only the environments that are on, and lists unchecked installations behind one line in [#3612](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3612) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(muster)* Tell two organizations' connectors of one name apart on the Connectors page in [#3608](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3608) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
